caption: A clear glass beaker of water is placed in front of a ruled sheet, and the lines behind the beaker appear closer together and shifted.

sa.check: A glass beaker of water is placed in front of it.
The lines behind the beaker appear closer together and shifted.
The beaker is placed first and the shift appears with it.

pc.expect: The change is confined to the view through the water and vanishes when the beaker is moved aside.
pc.fail: Lines beside the beaker change; or lines behind it are unchanged; or the change stays after the beaker is gone.

pc.expect: The sheet is unchanged; the shift is an appearance.
pc.fail: The lines on the sheet move; or the sheet bends; or a different pattern appears.

pc.expect: The beaker is rigid and the water level.
pc.fail: The beaker bends; or the water tilts and holds; or goes opaque.

pc.expect: The beaker and the sheet stay put unless moved.
pc.fail: The beaker slides; or the sheet moves; or the image shifts with both still.
The beaker duplicates; or the sheet vanishes; or the beaker passes through the sheet.

pc.expect: The sheet and the beaker stay the same.
pc.fail: The sheet changes colour; or the beaker changes shape; or the table changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
